course_title: RAISE (Responsible AI for Social Empowerment and Education)
course_description: RAISE (Responsible AI for Social Empowerment and Education) is a new MIT-wide initiative headquartered in the {{% resource_link "80004932-d5d0-49cc-afdf-cf092ec7eafd" "MIT Media Lab" %}} and in collaboration with the {{% resource_link "34396d3d-0b45-45a8-9e27-3f06b4b8ba48" "MIT Schwarzman College of Computing" %}} and {{% resource_link "cd9f1292-7165-41f2-a899-c9a5f58db71e" "MIT Open Learning" %}}. MIT researchers continually develop {{% resource_link "a8000275-43bc-4d1f-a80a-7527aa57a877" "curriculum modules and associated teaching materials" %}} that are available to all K-12 educators for free under a Creative Commons license.
